definitions.gloss: public will; popular opinion; the will of the people
definitions.explanation: The collective opinion or desire of the general public, especially in political contexts.

examples.japanese: {民意|みんい}を{反映|はんえい}させる。
examples.english: To reflect the will of the people.

examples.japanese: {選挙|せんきょ}は{民意|みんい}を{示|しめ}す{大切|たいせつ}な{機会|きかい}だ。
examples.english: Elections are an important opportunity to show the will of the people.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}は{民意|みんい}を{無視|むし}してはならないと、{野党|やとう}が{強|つよ}く{批判|ひはん}した。
examples.english: The opposition strongly criticized the government, saying it must not ignore the will of the people.

notes:
A formal term used primarily in political and journalistic contexts. Composed of {民|みん} (people) + {意|い} (will, intention).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {民意|みんい}を{反映|はんえい}する (reflect public opinion)
- {民意|みんい}を{問|と}う (ask the public; put to public judgment)
- {民意|みんい}を{無視|むし}する (ignore the will of the people)
- {民意|みんい}に{沿|そ}う (align with public opinion)
- {民意|みんい}を{汲|く}み{取|と}る (gauge public sentiment)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {世論|よろん} — public opinion (broader, includes surveys and polls)
- {国民|こくみん}の{声|こえ} — the voice of the people (more informal expression)
- {民|たみ}の{心|こころ} — the heart of the people (literary/classical)
